title: Conversion to circuit bit sources
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb N$, let $\rho$ assign a natural number to each of the eleven registers, and let $s$ be a tableau-bit source. Its corresponding circuit bit source is given as follows: a constant remains that Boolean constant; $z$ becomes input bit $\rho(8)$; $u$ becomes input bit $\rho(1)+\rho(9)$; a previous-configuration bit $(d,j)$ becomes block bit $j$ of block $\rho(4)+d-1$; a current-configuration bit $j$ becomes block bit $j$ of block $\rho(3)-1$; a position bit $j$ becomes block bit $j$ of block $\rho(5)-1$; and an end-of-tape bit $(\tau,j)$ becomes block bit $j$ of block $\rho(5)+(\tau+1)(2\rho(2)+1)-1$. All arithmetic in block indices is natural-number arithmetic, with subtraction truncated at zero.
hypotheses_covered: $\rho$ assigns natural numbers to the eleven registers
